claims.assertion: Mari says wet medical pods use high-energy holography and stem-cell fluid to repair tissue, restore bodies, and regrow limbs; they also serve cosmetic enhancement.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Mari describes Hyades as a 310-meter Taygetan light destroyer with four plasma-turbine engines, automation, self-repairing alloys, and holographic AI, but limited crew leisure space.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Mari says Hyades joined Toleka and Águila Vigilante in low Earth orbit as an escort, following an attack on Queen Alenym and Taygetan military escalation.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
